title: PortfolioContract
description: Canonical JSON Schema for portfolio snapshot and history endpoints under /api/v1/portfolio. Snapshots record daily total watchlist value per authenticated user; return percentages are computed at read time.

HistoryDays.description: History window length in calendar days for GET /api/v1/portfolio/history.

TotalValue.description: Portfolio total value in base currency with up to two fractional digits. Backend persists as integer cents.

snapshot_date.description: UTC calendar date for this snapshot (YYYY-MM-DD).

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC when the snapshot row was first inserted.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC when total_value was last recomputed.

PortfolioSnapshot.description: One daily portfolio value snapshot for the authenticated user.

snapshot_date.description: UTC calendar date for this history point.

daily_change_pct.description: Day-over-day percent change. First point in the series is 0; later points use (value/previous_value - 1) × 100.

cumulative_return_pct.description: Return since the first point in the returned series. First point is 0; later points use (value/first_value - 1) × 100.

PortfolioHistoryPoint.description: Single point in a portfolio history time series with server-computed return percentages.

pnl_today.description: Absolute PnL versus the previous snapshot day.

pnl_7d.description: Absolute PnL versus the snapshot closest to seven calendar days ago.

pnl_30d.description: Absolute PnL versus the snapshot closest to thirty calendar days ago.

pnl_ytd.description: Absolute PnL versus the first snapshot on or after January 1 UTC of the current year.

PortfolioHistorySummary.description: Optional headline PnL summary cards for dashboard UI.

points.description: Ascending series of history points within the requested window.

summary.description: Optional PnL summary when enough history exists to compute headline cards.

created.description: True when a new row was inserted; false when today's snapshot was upserted.
